title: Exploring the molecular mechanism of Er Miao San for treating rheumatoid arthritis based on network pharmacology.
authors: Xuan, Zihua; Chen, Simeng; Men, Xiangwen; Wang, Jin; Cheng, Zhiluo; Liu, Min; Wang, Jiayu; Zhang, Min; Jia, Xiaoyi
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学和分子对接研究二妙散治疗类风湿关节炎的机制，虽涉及分子对接但核心是药物-靶点通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to elucidate the molecular mechanism of Er Miao San (EMS) in treating rheumatoid arthritis (RA) by integrating network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental validation. METHODS: Using public databases, potential targets of EMS, RA-related targets, and NF-kappaB pathway targets were cross-referenced to identify common genes. These were analyzed via protein-protein interaction (PPI)network, GO/KEGG enrichment analyses (via DAVID), and hub gene identification (using Cytoscape and cytoHubba). Core predictions were validated by molecular docking, with therapeutic efficacy confirmed in adjuvant-induced arthritis (AA)rats and NF-kappaB pathway inhibition confirmed in TNF-alpha-induced fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLSs). RESULTS: Integrated analysis identified 34 common targets of Er Miao San (EMS) for rheumatoid arthritis (RA) treatment, with NFKBIA, RELA, and TNF recognized as the top hub genes. Molecular docking revealed stable binding between these targets and the core active components (fumarine, berberine, and wogonin). Experimentally, EMS alleviated joint pathology in AA rats and concentration-dependently suppressed TNF-alpha-induced proliferation of FLSs and the secretion of IL-1beta and IL-6. Mechanistically, EMS inhibited NF-kappaB signaling by reducing the phosphorylation of IkappaBalpha and p65 and blocking the nuclear translocation of p65. CONCLUSION: The therapeutic effects of EMS on RA are mediated through the inhibition of the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, thereby elucidating its mechanism of action.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在通过整合网络药理学、分子对接和实验验证，阐明二妙散（Er Miao San, EMS）治疗类风湿关节炎（rheumatoid arthritis, RA）的分子机制。方法：利用公共数据库，将EMS的潜在靶点、RA相关靶点及NF-kappaB通路靶点进行交叉比对，以识别共同基因。通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interaction, PPI）网络、GO/KEGG富集分析（通过DAVID）及核心基因识别（使用Cytoscape和cytoHubba）对这些基因进行分析。核心预测通过分子对接验证，并在佐剂诱导性关节炎（adjuvant-induced arthritis, AA）大鼠中确认治疗效果，在TNF-alpha诱导的成纤维样滑膜细胞（fibroblast-like synoviocytes, FLSs）中确认NF-kappaB通路抑制。结果：整合分析确定了二妙散（EMS）治疗类风湿关节炎（RA）的34个共同靶点，其中NFKBIA、RELA和TNF被识别为最重要的核心基因。分子对接显示这些靶点与核心活性成分（延胡索乙素、小檗碱和汉黄芩素）之间具有稳定结合。实验上，EMS减轻了AA大鼠的关节病理，并浓度依赖性地抑制TNF-alpha诱导的FLSs增殖及IL-1beta和IL-6的分泌。机制上，EMS通过减少IkappaBalpha和p65的磷酸化及阻断p65的核转位来抑制NF-kappaB信号通路。结论：EMS对RA的治疗作用通过抑制NF-kappaB信号通路介导，从而阐明其作用机制。
